text: Targets x86 bare metal (no host OS dependency at runtime)
Includes a bootloader (own boot sector / boot stage that loads the kernel)
Includes a kernel that the bootloader transfers control to
Kernel produces output via VGA text mode (0xB8000 buffer)
No external libraries (freestanding, no libc/third-party deps)
Builds to a bootable image from the repo with a documented build
Runnable in QEMU (boots and shows kernel output)
Files placed in the current directory (self-contained project)
